reuse.why: Introduces one isHoliday helper in shared/schedules.ts and routes all three existing inline holiday checks (getNextDate, getDateWithSkippedWeekend, getDatesInRange) through it.

duplication.why: The holiday match is now defined once; the surrounding 'isWeekend || isHoliday' pairing is still repeated at the three sites, as it was before the change.

placement.why: The helper lives in shared/schedules.ts beside getDateWithSkippedWeekend, where the tree keeps weekend/holiday logic.

scope.why: Only the holiday comparison, its three call sites and one test change.

maintainability.why: A single matching definition is easy to extend, though the import is out of order and long lines are left unformatted.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none; every holiday check in the tree now calls isHoliday
